Repositories as first-class execution scope (KAIROS-A-0019) and the git forges behind them.

## repositories

### `POST /api/code-index/query-vector`

The vector of the text of a code search, made by the model of the
vectors of the index. Each member of the organization can call it.

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`QueryVectorRequest`](../schemas/#queryvectorrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`QueryVector`](../schemas/#queryvector) | The vector of the text |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The organization has no provider for the model (NO_QUERY_PROVIDER), or the model or the text is not correct (VALIDATION) |
| `502` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The provider did not give the vector (QUERY_VECTOR_FAILED) |

### `GET /api/repositories`

The repository directory (open tenant-wide), by slug. `?team=` narrows
to one owning team.

The response is a page, `{items, total, limit, offset}`, as for each
other list (KAIROS-T-0268). Until 0.11 it was an array of each
repository.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `team` | query | no | `string` | Only this team's repositories (UUID or slug). |
| `forge` | query | no | `string` | With `name`: the ONE repository registered under this forge (`github|gitlab|other`) and full name — how a checkout matches its git remote (KAIROS-T-0116). Returns an empty list when unknown. |
| `name` | query | no | `string` | `owner/repo`, paired with `forge`. |
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | Page size (default 50, max 200). |
| `offset` | query | no | `integer` | Rows to skip (default 0). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ListEnvelope_Repository`](../schemas/#listenvelope_repository) | Page of repositories, by slug |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown team |

### `POST /api/repositories`

Register a repository under its owning team (org admin, or a
`manage_tasks` holder on that team's delivery board — self-serve for
the team and its agents).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string`, nullable | Optional. A key that you choose for this write: 8 to 128 characters of letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' and '-' (a UUID is a good key). Send it when you may retry the request. For 24 hours, a request with the same key and the same arguments writes nothing and gives the first status and body again, with the header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. The same key with other arguments is refused with REQUEST_KEY_REUSED (KAIROS-A-0065). |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateRepositoryRequest`](../schemas/#createrepositoryrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`Repository`](../schemas/#repository) | Registered |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Neither org admin nor the owning team |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Slug or (forge, name) already registered; or REQUEST_KEY_REUSED: the Idempotency-Key was used for a different request |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Bad slug/forge, unknown team, or a field that does not have its form |

### `GET /api/repositories/{slug}`

One repository (open tenant-wide): the directory row plus its webhook
connection id and in-flight links — everything an agent reads before
working in, or filing against, a codebase.

`impacted_by` has the documents and the ADRs that impact the
repository (COLLIERY-T-0269): its vision, its architecture, the
decisions about it. It has the live items only.
`?include_deleted=true` adds the archived items, each marked with
`archived_at`.

`owner_team_adrs` has the other ADRs of the owner team (KAIROS-T-0599).
No `impacts` link names them. The newest come first, 50 at most.
A superseded ADR is not there. `owner_team_adrs_total` counts them all.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | path | yes | `string` | Repository slug (or UUID) |
| `include_deleted` | query | no | `boolean` | Include the archived documents and ADRs in `impacted_by` and `owner_team_adrs`, each marked with `archived_at`. Default false. |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`RepositoryDetail`](../schemas/#repositorydetail) | The repository |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown repository |

### `DELETE /api/repositories/{slug}`

Remove a repository (org admin, or `manage_structure` at the
organization, KAIROS-T-0337). Refused with 409 while live tasks or a

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | path | yes | `string` | Repository slug (or UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|

| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown repository |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Still referenced by tasks or a connection |

### `PATCH /api/repositories/{slug}`

Edit a repository (same gate as create, evaluated against the CURRENT
owner). Re-homing to another team does not touch the tasks that link to
the repository.

A body can have only the values that the repository has. That request
gets 200 with the repository, and the server writes nothing
(COLLIERY-T-0267).

To stop the code index builds of the repository, send
`{"code_index_build": "off"}` (KAIROS-T-0398). Kairos cancels the
build jobs of the repository that wait for a server, and their runs end
as failed. The builder adds no new job. Kairos does not stop a build
that runs now, but the build gets no further try. Send `"on"` to start
the builds again. The MCP tool `update_repository` does the same.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | path | yes | `string` | Repository slug (or UUID) |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`UpdateRepositoryRequest`](../schemas/#updaterepositoryrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`Repository`](../schemas/#repository) | Updated |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Neither org admin nor the owning team |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown repository |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Slug already taken |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Bad slug, unknown team, or a field that does not have its form |

### `GET /api/repositories/{slug}/code-indexes/builds`

The runs of the code index builder for a repository, newest first
(KAIROS-T-0331). The server keeps `limit` in the range 1 to 100, as it
does for each list (COLLIERY-T-0264). With no `limit`, it gives 20.
`offset` skips the newest runs: the pages (KAIROS-T-0584). `total` is
exact.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | path | yes | `string` | Repository slug (or UUID) |
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | The most runs in the answer: 20 when not given, 100 at most. |
| `offset` | query | no | `integer` | The runs to skip before the page, newest first: 0 when not given (KAIROS-T-0584). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`CodeIndexBuildList`](../schemas/#codeindexbuildlist) | The runs, newest first |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown repository |

### `GET /api/repositories/{slug}/code-indexes/commits`

One page of the indexed commits of a repository, newest write first
(KAIROS-T-0518). The server keeps `limit` in the range 1 to 200. The

Each row has the schema version of its index file.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | path | yes | `string` | Repository slug (or UUID) |
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | Page size (default 50, max 200). |
| `offset` | query | no | `integer` | Rows to skip (default 0). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ListEnvelope_CodeIndex`](../schemas/#listenvelope_codeindex) | A page of the indexed commits, newest first |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown repository |

### `POST /api/repositories/{slug}/code-indexes/rebuild`

Ask the builder for a full build of the code index of a repository

The request resets the breaker of the code index builder of the
repository (`code_index_breaker`, KAIROS-T-0399).

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | path | yes | `string` | Repository slug (or UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `202` | [`CodeIndexBuild`](../schemas/#codeindexbuild) | The run, as `running` |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | No right to change the repository |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown repository |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | A run of the repository is active (CODE_INDEX_BUILD_RUNNING) |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The repository has the builder off (CODE_INDEX_BUILD_OFF), or the request has a body |
| `503` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The deployment has no builder (CODE_INDEX_BUILDER_OFF) |

### `PUT /api/repositories/{slug}/code-indexes/{commit}`

Send the index file of a commit. Kairos adds its summaries to the pool
of the repository and keeps its structure for the commit. A commit that
has an index gets the new one.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | path | yes | `string` | Repository slug (or UUID) |
| `commit` | path | yes | `string` | The full commit id |
| `ref` | query | no | `string` | The branch, the pull request or the tag that the index is for, for example `main`, `pull/12` or `v1.0.0`. |

Request body (required): `application/vnd.sqlite3`, [`IndexFile`](../schemas/#indexfile)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`UploadedCodeIndex`](../schemas/#uploadedcodeindex) | Stored; it replaces the index of the commit |
| `201` | [`UploadedCodeIndex`](../schemas/#uploadedcodeindex) | Stored; the commit had no index |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | No right to change the repository |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown repository |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The vectors are of another model than the pool of the repository |
| `413` | — | The file is larger than 256 MiB |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Bad commit or ref, or a body that is not an index file |

Test the read token: `git ls-remote` of the URL of the repository with

is a 200 with `last_check_ok: false` and the error of git, with the
token removed.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | path | yes | `string` | Repository slug (or UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`RepositoryCredential`](../schemas/#repositorycredential) | The check ran. `last_check_ok` has the result |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an organization admin, and not a member of the owner team |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown repository, or the repository has no token |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The stored token does not decrypt with the key of the deployment |

### `GET /api/repositories/{slug}/import-issues`

The last import of the open issues of a repository (KAIROS-T-0487).

Organization admin only. The answer gives the state of the import and
its counts. It also gives the interval of the repository and its sync
state (KAIROS-T-0670). The sync state has the last complete run, the next
run and the count of the record. It also has the counts of the last run
and the last error. A repository with an interval answers before its
first job, with the state `idle`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | path | yes | `string` | Repository slug (or UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`IssueImport`](../schemas/#issueimport) | The last import |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown repository, or no import ran |

### `POST /api/repositories/{slug}/import-issues`

Start the import of the open issues of a repository (KAIROS-T-0483).

Organization admin only. The import is a job of the job queue
(KAIROS-T-0487).

Each open issue goes through the path of an opened-issue event. The
forge filter decides. Then Kairos makes one support task for each issue
id on the delivery board of the team. The import skips an issue that a
webhook or an earlier import took.

The repository needs a read token with Issues: read (GitHub) or
`read_api` (GitLab). It needs no webhook connection.

The answer is the job, at once. While an import of the repository waits
or runs, the answer is that import: one runs at a time. Read the counts
with `GET /api/repositories/{slug}/import-issues`.

The interval of the repository (`issue_import_interval`, KAIROS-T-0670)
runs the same import on a cadence.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | path | yes | `string` | Repository slug (or UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `202` | [`IssueImport`](../schemas/#issueimport) | The import job: a new one, or the one that waits or runs |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown repository |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The repository has no read token, or the forge `other` |

| `501` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The deployment has no site store (NO_SITE_STORE) |

Set or replace the write token of a GitHub or GitLab repository. An

encrypts the token. Then Kairos writes each open pull request that
links to an item, and each issue whose task changed. The response is
the status, with no token.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | path | yes | `string` | Repository slug (or UUID) |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`SetRepositoryCredentialRequest`](../schemas/#setrepositorycredentialrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`RepositoryWriteBack`](../schemas/#repositorywriteback) | The token is set |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an organization admin, and not a member of the owner team |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown repository |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not a GitHub or GitLab repository, an unknown field, or a token that is empty, too long or has a space |
| `501` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | This deployment has no KAIROS_SECRETS_KEY |

## forge

### `GET /api/forge-connections`

Every live connection (open tenant-wide; secrets never included).

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | array of [`ForgeConnection`](../schemas/#forgeconnection) | Live connections, newest first |

### `POST /api/forge-connections`

Connect webhooks for a registered repository (org admin). Returns the
delivery URL and the secret — **the only time the secret is ever
shown**. The repository's forge is the webhook dialect; `other` repos
cannot be connected.

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateForgeConnectionRequest`](../schemas/#createforgeconnectionrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`CreatedForgeConnection`](../schemas/#createdforgeconnection) | Connected; webhook_secret is shown once |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an org admin |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown repository |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Repository already connected |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Repository has no webhook-capable forge |
| `501` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Deployment not configured for webhooks |

### `POST /api/forge-connections/{id}/rotate`

Rotate a connection's secret. Because the secret is DERIVED from the
connection id, rotation mints a **new connection** (same repo, new id)
and disconnects the old one — so the delivery URL changes too and the
operator updates both fields in the forge.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | Connection id (UUID) |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
